input: RGB 224x224 letterbox, ImageNet mean/std; frozen 1280-dimensional features
training: Frozen ImageNet MobileNetV2 + StandardScaler + multinomial LogisticRegression C=0.1
limitations: Dataset-only evaluation; pHash groups reduce but cannot eliminate source/specimen leakage. Not independent field validation. Healthy means no visible supported disease. No reliable out-of-distribution or crop detector.
retirement_reason: User requested removal of MobileNetV2 models
